# Legacy Microservice Repository

This repository contains backend microservices for order processing and payments.

## Architecture
See the code files in `/services/order/main.go` and `/services/payment/client.go`.
Authentication is handled by `pkg/auth/contract.go`.

## Setup
Run the services using go:
```bash
go run services/order/main.go
```
